featured_reviews.name: Santosh P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bored of ordering from the usual places, decided to give this place a try going by the reviews on google. Ordered their special biriyani, chicken sukka and naan. The chicken sukka was tasty with decent amount of chicken pieces, though the quantity would be too less for one person. The naan was soft and fluffy. The biriyani was definitely delicious, aromatic and freshly prepared. However, I was extremely unhappy with the chicken pieces (3 chunks) which were almost bare bones with little to no flesh. Not sure if this was because I ordered via zomato instead of directly from them. I'm sure customers won't mind paying extra if needed to get succulent and tender pieces of the meat which everyone prefers.
I'd compliment them on the taste of the biriyani, which lingered even after I'd finished the bowl. The low amount of meat is definitely something that made the entire experience disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Shashikant Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I recently ordered from Biryani Curry Fusion for a birthday party, and it was an absolute hit! We ordered 3kg of Chicken Dum Biryani and 2kg of Paneer Biryani, and everything was perfect.
​The taste was authentic and flavorful, the meat was tender, and the paneer was incredibly soft. I was also really impressed with the presentation and the generous quantity—it was more than enough for our guests. If you're looking for quality biryani for an event or just a meal, I highly recommend giving them a try!

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Sodha
featured_reviews.review_text: Ordered Paneer tikka Biryani and Paneer Roll, and both were absolutely delicious! The delivery was super fast, and the food arrived hot and fresh. The paneer was incredibly soft, and the flavors were perfect. I loved both the dishes and will definitely be ordering again soon. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Google Review (Friendly & Detailed for a Broader Audience):

Rating: ★★★★★

Tried Bombay Sultani Biryani House for the first time and was genuinely impressed!
The Egg Biryani (₹159) is a great value — perfectly spiced, with fluffy rice and well-cooked eggs that soak up the masala beautifully. The Soya Chaap Biryani (₹199) is a surprise winner — rich in flavor and texture, great for vegetarians or anyone wanting a twist on traditional biryani.

The Chicken Seekh Biryani (their bestseller) absolutely lives up to the hype — juicy seekh kebabs layered with aromatic rice. A must-try!

Starters were also on point:

Chicken Koliwada was crispy, tangy, and spicy — just the way it should be.

Keema Pav Irani Style had bold, nostalgic flavors — soft pavs and a generous portion of flavorful keema.

Highly recommended if you're craving biryani with a punch of Mumbai-style flair.

Best place in the locality, 5 stars all across.

They have the best possible varieties of Indian food, authentic as well as with modern twists. They give a great representation to seafood and chicken dishes from Konkan region. The chicken patiyala main course was rich and flavorful, paired perfectly with their garlic naan.They also offer a variety of options for vegetarians too.

Overall, I highly recommend if you're in Kandivali. I'll definitely be returning soon!

Overall, a solid place to eat, drink, chill, and spend quality time without burning a hole in your pocket. Total Mumbai classic 🍻

featured_reviews.name: Prashant “Paddy” Demello
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sarova Restaurant and Bar has always caught my eye while passing by the highway—there’s something inviting about its look and location. When I finally stopped by, I was genuinely impressed with the interior and rooftop section. It has a cozy, laid-back vibe that’s rare to find in a highway-side bar. The ambiance feels just right for a casual drink or quick hangout, especially in the evenings.

But unfortunately, that’s where the positives ended for me.

The food and service were a big letdown. I ordered chicken lollipop, but the head waiter kept insisting I try the tandoor version instead. When I clearly told him I wasn’t interested and that I’d rather skip it if the regular lollipop wasn’t available, he suddenly said, “We do have the lollipop.” It felt very manipulative and pushy.

A similar thing happened with the veg starters. We ordered mushroom, but they brought paneer instead—and again, the waiter tried hard to convince us to just go with it. When we refused, he said mushroom would take 20 minutes. We agreed to wait, but then suddenly he claimed they were out of mushrooms altogether. This kind of flip-flop and forceful attitude really ruined the experience.

Food quality was average at best, and the overall attitude of the staff made it feel like they were more interested in pushing what’s convenient for them than giving the customer what they want.

In summary: Beautiful setting, poor service. Will I return? Only if it’s just for a drink—not for food.

featured_reviews.name: Prasad Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had booked the avenue for our sangeet & engagement function in December 2024. 200 PAX. While our overall experience was amazing, please read the CONS section!

PROS -
- Amazing location, the area was more than big enough for us. The have one small space and one large space divided, as per your need & party size you can choose one or both.
- Decor was on point. They have their own vendor for the same who has monopoly, but Shweta knows her stuff, and will help you achieve the best possible decor in your budget. Totally Trustworthy, just be clear and detailed in your brief and references
- Food - Bang on. Worth every penny, all of our guests mentioned great stuff & compliments about the food, starters and welcome drinks. On request, the starters where circulated for much longer than the usual time as well. The staff service was very well executed too. Kudos to Subhash sir.

CONS -
- The DJ and lights vendor (Sanjay), who they have appointed, and who has monopoly there, was the only thing that didn't work out for us. As our timing were a little extended due to back to back functions the same day, we were asked to pay for 2 shifts for the DJ. Which we agreed on, also extra amounts where paid for stage lightings as well for Dance performances, as they weren't a part of the DJ or Decor Setup.
- Inspite of paying everything in advance to the said vendor, things werent planned properly. We made a pro active effort of providing all music files for the DJ night and performances well in advance, the DJ was totally unprepared and didn't have any files with him, inspite of everything being shared with him a week prior. By God' s Grace, we had a backup plan with backup pendrives, and yet still the DJ managed to screw things up and didnt play the tracks as per the given order or on time.
- There were 6-7 Pendrives given to the DJ by different parties for the sangeet choreographed performances. We got none of them back
- The DJ was not informed that its a double shift, hence he didn't start the soft music sessions on time. We know this because he actually said to us "Your sangeet and function starts at 6, why do you need music from 4 PM"?. The double shift was booked from 4 PM - 10 PM.
- The vendor (Sanjay)  was very pro active with us, till the payment went to him. Post that, everything was a blunder.
- Of course in our post event feedback we mentioned all of this to the owner. A few days later the said vendor called us on our honeymoon, and had the audacity to say "Aap mera naam kharab kar rahe ho, maine aapko apna best DJ diya tha" :/

So overall, i would say this place is lovely, in terms of the food, venue and decor. But if your event is lights and sangeet based, please have proper meetings with the vendor and meet the DJ well in advance, because we still regret not meeting the DJ personally before our event. This is especially important for wedding related events.
